# Workflow atlas

This atlas connects the existing R package, Python video runner, JavaScript explorer and scientific protocol documents. Each workflow is a **research process**, not a guarantee of externally validated accuracy.

<figure class="aqt-figure"><img src="../workflow.svg" alt="Seven connected modules from acquisition to review." loading="lazy"></figure>

<p class="aqt-figure-caption">Use the linked function reference for precise arguments and return values.</p>

## Workflow A — A single-camera experiment

**Inputs:** original video, frame presentation timestamps, known calibration or scale where applicable, fish-trained detector weights or independently generated tracks, treatment/event log.

1. Inspect the source recording and clock metadata.
2. Decode and track fish with the optional Python runner, or supply externally generated MOT/YOLO/idtracker.ai output.
3. Validate the frame manifest and import the complete video bundle.
4. Inspect missed detections, ID switches and frame coverage against independently annotated frames.
5. Calculate gap-safe kinematics and event-relative summaries.
6. Report the number of **independent tanks**, not just fish or frames.

**Functions:** [`aqt_frame_manifest()`](../reference/aqt_frame_manifest.html), [`aqt_video_bundle_import()`](../reference/aqt_video_bundle_import.html), [`aqt_detection_metrics()`](../reference/aqt_detection_metrics.html), [`aqt_tracking_metrics()`](../reference/aqt_tracking_metrics.html), [`aqt_kinematics()`](../reference/aqt_kinematics.html), [`aqt_align_events()`](../reference/aqt_align_events.html).

## Workflow B — Two synchronized cameras to 3D

**Inputs:** two camera PTS timelines, independently estimated synchronization markers, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, lens and refraction parameters, image locations and fish correspondence hypotheses.

1. Validate synchronized timing from independent holdout markers.
2. Correct the declared lens distortion.
3. Declare physical refractive geometry for air–water or air–glass–water rays.
4. Generate provisional cross-view fish candidates; withhold ambiguous identities.
5. Reconstruct only supported paired tracks, preserving source IDs and physical diagnostics.
6. Test physical reconstruction against independent XYZ reference targets.

**Functions:** [`aqt_sync_holdout_fit()`](../reference/aqt_sync_holdout_fit.html), [`aqt_brown_undistort_tracks()`](../reference/aqt_brown_undistort_tracks.html), [`aqt_flatport_camera()`](../reference/aqt_flatport_camera.html), [`aqt_crossview_auto_associate()`](../reference/aqt_crossview_auto_associate.html), [`aqt_auto_refractive_pipeline()`](../reference/aqt_auto_refractive_pipeline.html), [`aqt_target_holdout_benchmark()`](../reference/aqt_target_holdout_benchmark.html).

<figure class="aqt-figure"><img src="../multiview.svg" alt="Conceptual dual camera geometry over an aquarium with fish and observation rays." loading="lazy"></figure>

<p class="aqt-figure-caption">Illustrative only: camera positions and ray lines are not measured calibration values.</p>

## Workflow C — Detector and tracking validation

**Inputs:** locked predictions plus independent labels for sampled frames including empty frames.

- Detection: precision, recall, F1, IoU, AP/mAP.
- Identity: IDF1, identity switches and matched positional errors.
- Sampling: documented frame inclusion probabilities and review completeness.
- External trackers/official protocols: distinguish these from native approximate metrics.

**Functions:** [`aqt_annotation_frame_plan()`](../reference/aqt_annotation_frame_plan.html), [`aqt_annotation_plan_audit()`](../reference/aqt_annotation_plan_audit.html), [`aqt_video_bundle_benchmark()`](../reference/aqt_video_bundle_benchmark.html).

## Workflow D — Tank-replicated event analysis

**Inputs:** logged onset times, treatment assignment by independently replicated tank, observed fish paths and specified windows.

<figure class="aqt-figure"><img src="../tank-design.svg" alt="Three separate treatment A tanks and three treatment B tanks containing repeated fish observations." loading="lazy"></figure>

<p class="aqt-figure-caption">Conceptual replication design; not an empirical study or prescribed sample size.</p>

**Functions:** [`aqt_design_audit()`](../reference/aqt_design_audit.html), [`aqt_event_epoch_summary()`](../reference/aqt_event_epoch_summary.html), [`aqt_tank_event_contrast()`](../reference/aqt_tank_event_contrast.html), [`aqt_functional_tank_contrast()`](../reference/aqt_functional_tank_contrast.html).

## Workflow E — Behavioural and functional trajectories

**Inputs:** observed time series with gap handling and explicit support across fish/tanks.

**Methods:** change-point summaries, conditional Gaussian HMMs, DTW/recurrence, sparse FPCA, within-fish longitudinal models.

**Functions:** [`aqt_state_changepoint()`](../reference/aqt_state_changepoint.html), [`aqt_hmm_decode()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_decode.html), [`aqt_trajectory_dtw()`](../reference/aqt_trajectory_dtw.html), [`aqt_sparse_fpca_fit()`](../reference/aqt_sparse_fpca_fit.html), [`aqt_functional_longitudinal_fit()`](../reference/aqt_functional_longitudinal_fit.html).

## Workflow F — Uncertainty sensitivity

**Inputs:** externally assumed or independently estimated image, geometric, ID-switch and model errors.

**Approach:** keep the observational record immutable, generate specified perturbation scenarios, rerun downstream quantities and report conditional sensitivity separately from tank-sampling uncertainty.

**Functions:** [`aqt_trajectory_ensemble()`](../reference/aqt_trajectory_ensemble.html), [`aqt_identity_switch_scenarios()`](../reference/aqt_identity_switch_scenarios.html), [`aqt_joint_refractive_scenarios()`](../reference/aqt_joint_refractive_scenarios.html), [`aqt_joint_tank_sensitivity()`](../reference/aqt_joint_tank_sensitivity.html).

## Workflow G — Publish research figures

Export figure devices from base R, verify units and labels, and retain a provenance statement. See [publication figures](publication-figures.html) and the [figure gallery](visualization-gallery.html).

## Workflow H — Animal–Computer Interaction

Audit externally recorded action, detector, command and response timestamps and distinguish simulated logic from ethically reviewed physical hardware operation. See [ACI workflows](aci-workflows.html).

## Which workflow should I start with?

| Your dataset | Initial workflow | Next checkpoint |
|---|---|---|
| One GoPro, no annotations | A + C | Independently annotated evaluation frames |
| Two cameras, known calibration | B | Clock and physical XYZ holdouts |
| Tracking CSV only | A (from import) | Missing-frame and ID QC |
| Five fish, several tanks, event log | D | Confirm independent experimental tank count |
| Time-dependent state measurements | E | Observational gaps, state assumptions and tanks |
| Multiple uncertain fish identities | F | Sensitivity distributions, not certified intervals |
| ACI choice/actuator logs | H | Operator authorization, safety, external behavioural review |

The [source protocols](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/tree/v0.1.0/docs) provide further constraints and data schemas.
